<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **95** documentable anchor(s).

**36** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 351c22c9475ad8715a0fe8cbdbc341ea2453bd55`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `master_detail (literal, 43 pages)`
- **13** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **246** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **181** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **181**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **122** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **21** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 351c22c9475ad8715a0fe8cbdbc341ea2453bd55` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b0555649fb0515ed6728a41c43fdbfd81e4c8f30` — the merge of head `5da69c952c4757ea305dbc388f08f053f8f16924` into base `351c22c9475ad8715a0fe8cbdbc341ea2453bd55`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b0555649fb0515ed6728a41c43fdbfd81e4c8f30 && git checkout b0555649fb0515ed6728a41c43fdbfd81e4c8f30
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 351c22c9475ad8715a0fe8cbdbc341ea2453bd55 5da69c952c4757ea305dbc388f08f053f8f16924 && git checkout -B drift-repro 351c22c9475ad8715a0fe8cbdbc341ea2453bd55 && git merge --no-ff 5da69c952c4757ea305dbc388f08f053f8f16924

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 351c22c9475ad8715a0fe8cbdbc341ea2453bd55
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 351c22c9475ad8715a0fe8cbdbc341ea2453bd55` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `2e0c5ef6f54c6452b24ed2be0ecd60245b0deac0`
Local-runs: none

Face: the declaration alone (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`). The committed tree touches no `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path. Inputs read: card #31911 (body and all 15 comments, including ruling A on #31743 in record 6739066323, the edge-1 ruling 6768756192, the order amendments, and dev report 6768460771), ADR-0144 on `origin/main` (D2, D5 and D6 with their amendment notes, Open item 14), the PR body and its 19 files, the net diff against merge-base c147fc2360 (+1455/−74), and the head's check-runs. The diff's objectql files were read against the live tree at this head. Nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

Each widening of the accept set the diff implies, judged against the ruling and the ADR:

- **Right.** A child `record` amount whose `currencyField` is `MASTER_DETAIL.CODE` is stored under a coded parent, and is converted from the parent's code. On `main` the guard read the dotted key as a column, so every such amount was refused `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`. This follows D2 as amended: "the explicit stored value of D8 rule 4 is the parent's code".
- **Right.** A `summary` registers when it rolls up through the very `master_detail` that the amount follows (`rollupVerdict`: `path.master === parent && relation === path.via`). The aggregate is also checked again at recompute time: `ROLLUP_AGGREGATE_OPTION === path.via`. A roll-up through any other relation, over an amount that follows another object, or one level up stays refused with 422. This is D6 as amended: "admitted only through that very `master_detail` field".
- **Right.** The parent's code field locks (D2 as amended). See the lock notes below.
- **Right, per ruling A on edge 1 (6768756192).** Moving a child to another parent re-projects it. The `master_detail` is the pair's input in `recordCurrencyInputOf`, so the guard, `homeAmountsTouched` and the recompute's columns all key on it.
- **Right (D5 note).** `os migrate recompute-home-amounts` now runs over a path pointer. It reads the `master_detail` column, not the dotted projection.
- **No widening beyond these.**
  - **Edge 2 stays refused.** `assertRecordCurrencyAggregatesGrouped` refuses a path amount whatever its `groupBy` holds. That covers grouping by the `master_detail` itself and by the dotted parent path. The only pass is the roll-up channel.
  - **Datasets and cubes.** `services/service-analytics` is untouched. Its `cube-record-currency-door.ts` admits a measure only when a dimension of the amount's own object has the code as its column. A path amount never has one, so it fails closed.
  - **A `lookup` path pointer stays refused.** `recordCurrencyPathOf` leaves `master` undefined for any non-`master_detail` field. The guard then lays `null`, so the amount is refused. The summary verdict needs `path.master === parent`, the lock's follower index skips `master === undefined`, and the aggregate door refuses it.
- **Engine refusals the diff makes real** (judged right; they are not narrowings of a declared capability):
  - The raw aggregate grouped by the dotted pointer was admitted on `main` (`grouped.has('invoice.currency_code')`) and answered a mixed-currency sum. It is now refused. D6's first bullet refused it all along, and Open item 14 gave this reading of the parent-path half to #31911.
  - A `summary` declaring `currencyMode: 'record'` is now judged like a record-mode amount (`recordCurrencyAggregandOf`).
  - The code backfill refuses a path pointer before it reads anything. Open item 14, edge 3, stays undecided, and the diff adds no new write.
  - The `(widening)` arm stands.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset is `'@objectstack/objectql': minor`, and objectql is the one published package the diff moves. `@objectstack/dogfood` is `private: true`, and only its test changes. `Metadata-protocol: added` needs at least `minor`, so the level is met.
- The PR body carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added` and `Skills-docs: follow-up #31957`, each line-initial.
- The changeset carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`, each line-initial (lines 7 and 8).
- **Correction to the brief.** `Skills-docs:` is not owed in the changeset. AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 names two declarations for the PR body and the changeset: `Clause-②` and `Metadata-protocol`. pm-dispatch SKILL.md L313 puts the third line, `Skills-docs:`, in the PR body only.
- #31957 is open, `Blocked-by: #31910, #31911`. It names the path form, the roll-up and the lock, so the line is true.
- **Gates**, the head's check-runs, read at 2026-11-10T16:31:10Z. CI is re-running after the merge of `main`.
  - Totals: 50 runs, 23 success, 16 skipped, 11 in progress, 0 failure.
  - Already green: Check Changeset (the level-axis failure on 49c2a39e cleared with the body edit), Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, PR-body guards, Lint (ESLint, docs and code guards, PM dispatch-gates, repo and tooling, scoped), Type Check (source gates), Spec property liveness, Check PR Size.
  - Still in progress: Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Build Core, Type Check (workspace, consumer gates).
  - So "all green" is not yet in evidence.
  - The PR is still a draft.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's open questions in 6768460771:
1. **Clause-② pair.** Answer A, as the seat did. The measured widening is real. Both carriers read `yes (widening)` with `added`.
2. **Edge 1.** Ruled A (6768756192). Implemented as ruled: a `master_detail` change re-converts from the new parent's code, and the lock does not bind the child's `master_detail`. Recording the adoption in the ADR rides the post-merge `domain:skills` card that the ruling names.
3. **Edge 2.** Answer A: keep refusing until the maintainer rules. Verified in ①. Landing does not decide it.
4. **Edge 3.** Answer A: keep the refusal. No new cross-object write, and Open item 14 stays open.
5. **Preview leniency.** Accepted. The write's own prior row is the raw `readUpdatePriorRow`, so a withheld code column cannot bypass the write's lock. Only the preview is laxer.

The dev's out_of_scope_findings:
- **Class b** (the registry does not judge segment 2 of a path `currencyField`): **escalated to the seat to file a card.** It is the same seam as a shape the registry also admits through a single-object save: a `currencyMode: 'record'` summary over a child field that follows nothing. That summary would be labelled in the parent's currency while it holds another currency. On `main` too, so it does not block this PR.
- **Class a** (the cube door's remedy names `PREFIX + codeField`, which a path amount can never satisfy): **escalated to the seat to file a card** (service-analytics). The door fails closed; only the message misleads.
- The share-link drops a path pointer: carried by #31912.
- The skills Currency section: carried by #31957.
- The ADR-0144 D5 "resolved by" line: carried by the post-merge `domain:skills` card (6768756192). Draft #32221 is closed unmerged.
- The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no author note is owed.

### Findings (graded)

The brief's design questions are answered here. The declaration face's record carries no ④ section, so these are graded findings of this one record.

- **must-fix F1: the elevated parent read answers before the reference check, which leaks a parent row the writer cannot read.**
  - *Organization scope holds.* `parentRows` reads under `ObjectQL.referenceCheckContext` (`{ ...context, isSystem: true }`). The `tenantId` survives to the driver's tenant wall, so no other organization's parent is read.
  - *Row-level read does not hold.* On insert, `followParentCurrencyCodes` and `projectHomeAmounts` run before the validation loop (`engine-insert.ts` L1254–1265). The blank-code guard (L1322) runs before `assertReferencesResolve` (L1329–1334). Under #29029 and #22519, that check is what answers `reference_not_found` for a `master_detail` header the caller cannot read, "whatever a rule would answer".
  - *The leak.* A non-system writer can name the id of a same-organization parent it cannot read, on an object that is not `controlled_by_parent` (the CBP write gate is opt-in through `sharingModel`). It then gets one of three answers:
    - `ERR_EXCHANGE_RATE_MISSING`, whose message names the parent's currency;
    - `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`, meaning the parent's code is blank;
    - `reference_not_found`.
  - That is an existence and attribute oracle on a row the caller has no read on. The by-id update, the predicate update (re-parenting to such an id) and the `validate()` preview hold the same order.
  - *Fix.* On a non-system write, answer a followed parent that the caller's read door does not return as the reference check answers it (`masterDetailHeadersCallerReads`), before any currency verdict or rate lookup. Do not lay `PARENT_CODE_UNREAD` and skip, because that would store an unconverted amount (see F2).
  - *Pins.* Pin a same-organization parent the writer cannot read, and a parent in another organization, through `parentRows`. Neither is pinned today: the new suites cover only a parent that does not exist at all.
- **should-fix F2: skipping `PARENT_CODE_UNREAD` relies on a reference check that does not always run.**
  - `assertRecordCurrencyCodes` skips such a pair, and `projectHomeAmounts` writes nothing for it, because the symbol is no string. The docblock says "the reference check answers for it".
  - `assertReferencesResolve` returns early for a system caller (except a flow's elevated write). It also skips a `readonly` field and a non-scalar value, and it fails open when its probe throws.
  - So a system insert, or an update, that names a dangling or out-of-organization parent stores the child amount with no resolvable currency and no home projection. On an update it keeps the old parent's home amount, which contradicts D8 rule 4 and edge-1 ruling A.
  - Refuse `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` in every case where the reference check will not answer.
- **should-fix F3: the roll-up channel is reachable through a public export.**
  - The channel is unreachable from REST, MCP, the client and analytics:
    - the symbol is a `Symbol()`, not a `Symbol.for`, so it cannot be forged;
    - `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts` is not re-exported from `index.ts`;
    - every door builds its own aggregate options from JSON.
  - But `aggregateSummaryValue` IS a public export of `@objectstack/objectql` (`index.ts` L681). It sets the channel from a `desc` the caller supplies, and puts an unchecked `parentId` into `{ [fkField]: parentId }`.
  - A non-scalar `parentId` (for example `{ $ne: null }`) turns the "one parent" premise into a sum across parents, and the door then admits it. Every internal caller passes `String(id)`.
  - Refuse a non-string, non-number `parentId` (or set the channel only for one), so the claim "no door a caller reaches can set it" holds for the exported API too.
- **nit F4: the lock's recycle-bin read is wide.** `binRootsOf` follows `lookup` as well as `master_detail` targets, transitively, and `binEntries` reads every bin entry of those roots with no limit, parsing each snapshot. This happens once per follower, on every code change of a coded parent with no live child. It is correct (a superset), but its cost grows with the bin. Carry it to a follow-up.
- **nit F5: the PR body has gone stale.**
  - "Final head: `009a87ec2`": the head is now 2e0c5ef6.
  - 维护者速读 still routes the D5 line through "the ADR PR", which #32221 no longer is.
  - The Acceptance notes call edge 1 "not adopted … an open question", but 6768756192 ruled it A.
  - "Before this PR no such summary could register at runtime" overreaches: see class b above.

The lock itself refuses exactly what D2 rules:
- a non-blank stored code changed to another code or to blank, on the by-id path, the predicate path and the `validate()` preview, after the final payload;
- the same code again passes, and so does a first code over a blank one;
- rows in the recycle bin count;
- the answer is `VALIDATION_FAILED` / 400 with one `invalid_value` per code field, naming the child objects, and saying the code can change once no child follows;
- the child reads are elevated and keep the organization;
- the write's prior row is read raw, so a hidden column cannot bypass the lock.

Reviewed-by: `session_012dn2Ae4fomvXPZ2AioCpY4`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Written 2026-11-10T16:32Z. F1 is a must-fix and returns the PR to REWORK on the same branch. F2 and F3 ride the same rework. F4 is carried to a follow-up card. F5 is fixed with a body edit.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `5da69c952c4757ea305dbc388f08f053f8f16924`
Local-runs: none

**Delta review of FAIL record 6773022506** (head 2e0c5ef6). The face is the declaration alone, as before: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`, with no `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path in the committed tree.

**Scope.** The dev delta 2e0c5ef6..e156d14d, which is 814e8ddb9 (the fix), a67aaaa35 (the pins) and e156d14df (the changeset). That delta touches 9 files. I read it against the tree, not against report 6774236549. Then the seat's merge 5da69c95: its first parent is e156d14d and its second is `origin/main` at 351c22c9.

**The merge.** It brings in nothing that bears on this PR.
- The PR's net-diff patch-id at 5da69c95 against merge-base 351c22c9 equals the one at e156d14d against c147fc23: 44e7153de0e2f051f2b56effc6fe99ffd448df92 at both. The diff is 19 files, +1768/−81.
- Of the 227 paths `main` moved, one is a PR file: `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`. Its hunks are comment-only (L559 and L1054, the ADR-0150 action-holder docs) and touch nothing in the seam.
- The other objectql paths are `registry.ts` and the bare-name action-holder files. None of them touches `objectRevision`, `getAllObjects`, or any record-currency, home-amount, summary, write-path or recycle-bin file.

### ① Derived judgments

**F1: closed.**
- `HomeAmountServing.parentRows` now asks the writer's read door first, through `masterDetailHeadersCallerReads`: the predicate that the reference check uses for a `master_detail` header. Only ids that the door returns go on to the elevated `referenceCheckContext` read.
- An id the door does not return answers `PARENT_CODE_UNREAD` and is never read elevated. That covers a same-organization row the writer may not read, a row in another organization (the door runs under the writer's `tenantId`), and a row that does not exist.
- `assertRecordCurrencyCodes` answers such an amount first, with `buildFieldError` set to `reference_not_found` on the `master_detail` field and the same `constraint.target`. That is the reference check's own finding.
- So all three cases answer identically by construction, and no case gives a currency verdict.
- The insert projection still runs before the guard (`engine-insert.ts` L1248–1274). It reads no rate for the symbol, because a code that is not a string is skipped before `homeCurrency` and `rateOn` are called. So no `ERR_EXCHANGE_RATE_MISSING` or `ERR_HOME_CURRENCY_UNSET` can speak first.
- All four doors use the same serving: insert, by-id update, predicate update, and `validate()` (L578, through `ObjectQL#homeAmountServing`).
- A read door that throws returns an empty set, and that set answers `reference_not_found`, so the door fails closed.
- Pins: `inv_hidden` (EUR, same organization, Bob's) and `inv_other_org` (JPY, ORG_Y) are run over insert, by-id update, predicate update and both previews, against a lit control and a failing door. Ablation A1 is reported to turn 10 of them red.

**F2: closed.**
- `followParentCurrencyCodes` now lays `null` in place of the symbol in three cases: the elevated read finds no parent, the value is not a row id (an object or an array), or there is no reader at all. The guard then refuses `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`.
- A system writer's door returns every id (`masterDetailHeadersCallerReads` L509). So a system write naming a dangling parent or one in another organization is refused loudly rather than stored with no currency.
- The guard's update inputs (`pairInputsOf`) now include the amount's `homeAmount` inputs (`rateDate`, `field`, `rateField`). That matches the projection's own `projectionInputs`, so whenever the write converts an amount, the guard has already judged the parent it converts from.
- A system update that moves a line to a missing parent is refused, and the old home amount is not kept beside it (pinned).

**F3: closed.** `aggregateSummaryValue` sets `ROLLUP_AGGREGATE_OPTION` only when `parentId` is a non-empty string or a finite number. An operator object or a blank value is asked as any caller is asked, and the door refuses a path amount. Pinned, and ablation A4 is reported red.

**No regression against round 0's PASS items:**
- `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts` is not in the delta. Edge 2 (grouping by the `master_detail` or by the parent path) is still refused, and the one pass is still the channel equal to `path.via`.
- A `lookup` path pointer is still refused: `recordCurrencyPathOf` is unchanged, and `master === undefined` still lays `null`.
- The edge-1 re-projection is intact: `recordCurrencyInputOf` is unchanged, `pairInputsOf` contains the `master_detail`, and the projection's inputs are unchanged.
- The summary admission and the lock are untouched.

**No new widening.** The delta only adds refusals: `reference_not_found`, and `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` where round 0 skipped the amount. Each one closes a hole that round 0 named, so the `(widening)` arm stands.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset is unchanged in level (`'@objectstack/objectql': minor`) and in its two line-initial declarations. Only its prose moves, to describe the read door and the one-parent channel. The `minor` floor for `added` is met.
- The PR body still carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added` and `Skills-docs: follow-up #31957` line-initial.

**Gates on 5da69c95**, read at 2026-11-10T18:06:57Z. CI started again after the merge.
- Totals: 41 check-runs so far, 12 success, 16 skipped, 13 in progress, 0 failure.
- Green so far: Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Spec property liveness, Lint (PM dispatch-gates, tooling self-tests), Test UI.
- Still running: Build Core, Type Check (workspace, source, consumer gates, debt ledger), Lint (ESLint, repo and tooling, docs and code guards, CI/release/engine gates, two scoped), Plan Test Core shards, Live E2E UI. Test Core has not been planned yet.
- The patch-identical parent e156d14d was fully green when read the same minute: 52 runs, 36 success, 16 skipped, 0 failure.
- So all-green on the current head is not yet in evidence, and the landing waits on it.
- The PR is still a draft.

### ③ Boundary flags

**Open question from 6774236549: a `readonly` `master_detail` goes through the read door. Answer A, keep it.**
- The oracle that F1 closes does not depend on who minted the id. A hook-minted parent that the writer cannot read must not draw a currency verdict.
- Both options refuse. A gives the answer a reference gives, and states no currency.
- Accepted as a deliberate divergence from `assertReferencesResolve`, which exempts `readonly` fields.

The other out-of-scope findings carry as round 0 left them:
- Class b (the registry does not judge segment 2) and class a (the cube remedy text) stay with the seat, to be filed as cards after this round.
- F4 (the lock's recycle-bin read is unbounded) is an accepted deviation, carried to a follow-up card.
- F5 (stale PR body prose) is still open, and is fixed by a body edit before landing. The body still says "Final head: `009a87ec2`" and still routes the D5 line through an ADR PR.
- #31912, #31957 and the post-merge `domain:skills` card are unchanged.
- The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no author note is owed.

### Findings (graded)

- **nit F6: the read door binds wider than the reference check.** The guard's read door applies to two values the reference check leaves alone:
  - a parent the row already holds, unchanged, when an update touches only the amount or its document date (the stored-value exemption in `assertReferencesResolve`, #29062);
  - a value that a service verb vouches for (`isVouchedReference`).

  Both fail closed with `reference_not_found`; neither leaks. In the first case the finding names a field the writer did not send. Accepted as the conservative reading of F1. Record it with edge 1 on the post-merge `domain:skills` ADR-0144 card.

There is no must-fix and no should-fix. F4 and F5 stand as accepted, per round 0.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:server#5 · 2026-11-10T18:34Z

Head-sha: `5da69c952c4757ea305dbc388f08f053f8f16924` (the seat's merge of main over the REWORK round 1 head `e156d14d`; net-diff patch-id unchanged)

- **Shape:** 19+ files, about 1.5k lines, objectql only, under 3000 lines and no governed path. Built from the merged ADR-0144 amendment (ruling A on #31743, 6739066323):
  - a `MASTER_DETAIL.CODE` pointer is followed;
  - a summary rolls up through that same `master_detail`;
  - the parent's code locks per amended D2;
  - a child moved across parents re-projects (ruling A on edge 1, 6768756192).
- **Review records (TIER_DEFAULT, `Clause-②: yes` declaration face):** round 0 6773022506 (FAIL: F1 must-fix, F2/F3 should-fix), then delta 6775262964 (PASS on this head; F1–F3 closed, no regressions, merge delta clean).
- **What the review confirmed:**
  - Edge 2 (grouping by the master_detail) is still refused.
